{"consolidated_memory":"
SPURIOUS 429 ERRORS IN api/gateway/rate_limit.go — Six Separate Incidents

All incidents involved the same problem: spurious 429 rate limit errors returned by the API gateway limiter in api/gateway/rate_limit.go. All shared a common diagnostic signal: throttle counters reading far above the configured ceiling. All were reproduced using saved burst fixtures. Context from earlier spurious 429 work carried over throughout.

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-12]
Trigger: Traffic arriving through corporate proxy only
Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
PR #2718, branch fix/spurious-429-1
Outcome: Error rate dropped from 7.9 percent to under 4 per ten thousand

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-12]
Trigger: Occurred only after client had already retried once
Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialization
Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
PR #4991, branch fix/spurious-429-2
Outcome: Throughput rose 54 percent to 769 requests per second

OCCASION 3 [2026-03-25]
Trigger: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
PR #5817, branch fix/spurious-429-3
Outcome: Backlog cleared 7 minutes after deploy

OCCASION 4 [2026-06-09]
Trigger: Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
PR #6222, branch fix/spurious-429-4
Outcome: Job finished in 59 minutes instead of 8 hours

OCCASION 5 [2026-08-02]
Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR #8143, branch fix/spurious-429-5
Outcome: p99 latency fell from 4.3 seconds to 682 milliseconds

OCCASION 6 [2026-08-13]
Trigger: Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Fix: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
PR #9979, branch fix/spurious-429-6
Outcome: Flaky test went from 49 failures per hundred runs to zero
"}
